title: Personal Credit Cards: cashing out rewards points on a card being closed
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: closing points cash-out

This entry covers the Personal Credit Cards line of Piedmont Crescent Bank and is the invocation reference for cash_out_closing_card_points_6700a44f.

## What the policy governs

- **Situation:** a cardholder who is closing a card asks to cash out its rewards points.
- **Handling:** the points are cashed out as one deposit-to-checking redemption.
- **Result it decides:** the number of points cashed out.
- **Observable effect:** one redemption entry on the card for the points cashed out, recording the receiving checking account and the cash value, with the card's points reduced at once.
- **Record kept:** the cash-out is recorded on the card only, as a redemption entry that names the receiving checking account and carries the cash value. This card policy does not post the matching entry on the checking account's own ledger, and nothing in the policy reads or waits for that entry.

## How the tool is invoked

cash_out_closing_card_points_6700a44f is a customer-side tool. It must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves: the agent unlocks it with unlock_user_discoverable_tool, and the customer themselves then runs it.

## What one call does

One call cashes out rewards points from a credit card the cardholder is closing, as a deposit into the cardholder's PCB checking account, so the points are not lost. It posts one redemption entry on the card for the number of points given, records the receiving checking account and the cash value delivered, and lowers the card's unredeemed points balance by those points at once. The redemption entry on the card, naming the receiving checking account, is the record of the cash-out; the tool does not itself post an entry on the checking account's own ledger. The cardholder sees the points leave the card immediately. Whatever values are passed are booked as given; the tool performs no checks.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| card_account_id | the reference number of the credit card account whose points are cashed out, as returned by the card account lookup | reference number text |
| checking_account_id | the reference number of the cardholder's checking account that receives the cash, as returned by the checking account lookup or shown on the card's autopay instruction | reference number text |
| reward_points | how many points are cashed out | a whole positive integer with no decimal part; never empty for this call |
| amount | the cash value deposited | USD, a positive number rounded half-up to 2 decimal places; never empty for this call |

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary with: status (always "cashed_out" when the posting succeeded), card_txn_id (the new redemption entry), card_account_id, receiving_account_id (the checking account credited), reward_points (points cashed out), amount (USD, 2 decimal places, cash value deposited), posted_date (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and new_rewards_balance (the card's unredeemed points afterwards). The call is complete when the receipt comes back with status "cashed_out"; the tool has no other defined outcome.
